details.description: Erase (Stable Image Erase Object) is one of Stability AI's Stable Image Edit services, offered on Amazon Bedrock as stability.stable-image-erase-object-v1:0. Given an input image and a mask -- either a supplied black-and-white mask image or the input image's alpha channel -- it removes the masked object or area and reconstructs the background behind it, without needing a text prompt.
advantages: AWS Bedrock documentation says the service 'intelligently maintains background consistency' when removing a masked object.
Accepts a grow_mask parameter (0 to 20 pixels, default 5) that expands and blurs the mask edges to smooth the transition around the removed area, per AWS Bedrock documentation.
disadvantages: Requires a mask, either a separate mask image or the input image's alpha channel, to indicate what to remove; there is no automatic object-detection mode.
The input image must be between 64 pixels per side and 9,437,184 total pixels, with an aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1, per AWS Bedrock documentation.
use_cases: Removing an unwanted object or element from a photo while preserving the surrounding background
Cleaning up product or marketing photos before publishing

sources.title: Stability AI Image Services - Amazon Bedrock

notes: Only one URI targets this model (Bedrock). AWS Bedrock's documented request parameters for Erase list only image, mask, seed, output_format and grow_mask -- no text-prompt field -- while the catalog's facts list text_input among this model's modalities; kept the catalog's modality value as instructed but flagging the mismatch. Stability's own API-reference docs did not return readable content to the fetch tool (single-page app), so parameter detail comes from AWS Bedrock's documentation of the same service.
